newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale saw reasonable competition.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale saw reasonable competition.

text.p: The penultimate Scottish wool sale of the season held on March 26 saw 2,591,000 kilos of British Wool offered, the Committee of London Wool Brokers reported.
Reasonable competition was seen during the sale although interest in Blackface was more selective. About 75 percent of the catalogue was sold.
Compared with the previous Scottish sale on February 12, Best Cheviots were 2.5 percent cheaper with Cast grades 2.5 percent dearer.
Best Halfbreds sold in buyers favour and Cast Halfbrds sold in sellers favour. Crossed were 2.5 percent cheaper and Blackface was 2.5/5 percent cheaper.
